articles.headline: Which Semiconductor ETF Is Winning The AI Race In 2026?
articles.summary: PSI has outperformed every major semiconductor ETF in 2026. Here's why Nvidia's weighting has created a nearly 40-point performance gap.
articles._summary: The artificial intelligence race has made semiconductors the stock market’s best-performing industry in 2026, but not every ETF has benefited equally. The gap between the strongest and weakest semiconductor ETF has stretched to nearly 40 percentage points through July 6, and it traces back to a single stock. Over the same stretch, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ: SMH ) , the largest fund in the group with $70.59 billion in assets, has returned 66.2%.

articles.headline: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 21 killed in Kyiv region
articles.summary: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.
articles._summary: Watch: Russian attack leaves hole in Kyiv residential building The Ukrainian Air Force says a "serious shortage" of interceptor missiles meant none of the 23 ballistic missiles fired by Russia at Kyiv on Sunday night were shot down. At least 15 people were killed in the second large-scale Russian attack on the Ukrainian capital in a week, officials said. Six more were killed in the wider Kyiv region. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has appealed for allies to take "strong decisions" at this week's Nato summit to provide Kyiv with air defences. After the strikes, he said the Ukrainian military had been successful in intercepting cruise missiles and drones â but not ballistic missiles. Sunday's "massive Russian attack" consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones, he said in a post on X. The air force shot down or suppressed 37 missiles and 326 drones, it said.

articles.headline: Huge crowds fill Tehran streets for Khamenei's funeral procession
articles.summary: Many people were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance for the former supreme leader's war death.
articles._summary: 'The spectacle Iran wants the world to see': Lyse Doucet in Tehran Huge crowds have lined the streets of Tehran for the funeral procession of Iran's late supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who was killed on the first day of the war with the US and Israel. Footage from Iranian state TV showed many tens of thousands of mourners gathered to watch Khamenei's flag-draped coffin being transported by a lorry along a 10km (6-mile) route that passed through the capital's landmark Enghelab Square. The procession took place after his body lay in state for two days at Tehran's Grand Mosalla mosque. Three of Khamenei's sons prayed beside his coffin there on Sunday. But Mojtaba, the son who succeeded him as supreme leader, did not make an appearance. He has not been seen in public since reporting being seriously wounded in the same Israeli air strike in Tehran on 28 February that killed his father and his wife.
articles._zh_headline: 德黑兰街道挤满了大批人群参加哈梅内伊的送葬队伍
articles._zh_summary: “伊朗希望全世界看到的奇观”：德黑兰的莱瑟·杜塞特 (Lyse Doucet) 德黑兰的街道两旁挤满了大批人群，参加伊朗已故最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊的送葬队伍。哈梅内伊在与美国和以色列的战争的第一天被杀。伊朗国家电视台的画面显示，数以万计的哀悼者聚集在一起，观看一辆卡车沿着一条10公里（6英里）​​的路线运送哈梅内伊的灵柩，这条路线穿过首都地标性建筑恩赫拉布广场。游行活动是在他的遗体在德黑兰大莫萨拉清真寺安放两天后举行的。周日，哈梅内伊的三个儿子在他的棺材旁祈祷。但接替他成为最高领袖的儿子莫吉塔巴却没有露面。自从 2 月 28 日以色列对德黑兰的空袭导致他的父亲和妻子身亡后，他就没有在公开场合露面。

articles.author: Piero Cingari
articles.headline: Inflation Turns Negative as Hormuz Reopens: Why Gold, Silver, Bitcoin May Now Rally
articles.summary: As oil slides and US jobs data cools, the Fed's rate-hike bets are unwinding, and gold, silver and Bitcoin are the early winners of the shift.
articles._summary: For most of 2026, gold, silver and Bitcoin have been a painful place to put money. The reason is not hard to find: a fast-shifting outlook for Federal Reserve policy. The year opened with hopes for rate cuts. Then the war in Iran sent energy prices surging, revived inflation, and flipped the market’s bet from lower rates to higher ones. For gold, silver and Bitcoin, assets that pay no yield and rise or fall on the path of interest rates, that shift was brutal.
articles._zh_headline: 随着霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，通货膨胀转为负数：为什么黄金、白银、比特币现在可能会反弹
articles._zh_summary: 在 2026 年的大部分时间里，黄金、白银和比特币一直是一个痛苦的投资场所。原因不难发现：美联储政策前景的快速变化。新年伊始，人们就抱有降息的希望。随后，伊朗战争导致能源价格飙升，通胀再度抬头，并将市场押注从较低利率转向较高利率。对于黄金、白银和比特币这些不支付收益且随利率上升或下降的资产来说，这种转变是残酷的。

articles.headline: Micron vs. SK Hynix: Nvidia's Top AI Memory Suppliers Are Set for a Wall Street Showdown
articles.summary: Micron has long been Wall Street's AI memory favorite, but SK hynix's Nasdaq debut pits Nvidia's top memory suppliers on one exchange.
articles._summary: The listing gives U.S. investors direct access to SK Hynix alongside Micron, which has until now been the primary U.S.-listed pure-play memory company benefiting from the AI boom. Both companies have emerged as beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure buildout, with investors increasingly favoring suppliers of critical components over technology companies that are spending billions to develop AI capabilities. The South Korean chipmaker has established itself as one of NVIDIA’s largest suppliers of AI memory chips.

articles._zh_summary: 此次上市让美国投资者可以直接投资 SK 海力士和美光科技，后者迄今为止是第一家从人工智能热潮中受益的在美国上市的纯存储公司。两家公司都成为人工智能基础设施建设的受益者，投资者越来越青睐关键零部件的供应商，而不是花费数十亿美元开发人工智能能力的科技公司。这家韩国芯片制造商已成为 NVIDIA 最大的 AI 存储芯片供应商之一。
